name: andorlabs
description: And/or Labs marketplace. Hosts the Fix My Positioning plugin — a B2B startup positioning audit and rewrite toolkit grounded in five non-overlapping frameworks (Dunford, JTBD/ODI, Raskin, VPC, Challenger) and Fletch PMM execution-layer detection.

plugins.name: fix-my-positioning
plugins.description: Grades B2B startup positioning on a 0–10 scale across five orthogonal diagnostic frameworks (Dunford / JTBD+ODI / Raskin / VPC / Challenger), runs the Fletch PMM execution-layer detector module against the homepage (13 failure-pattern + 7 positive-signal detectors plus a 9-element clarity heatmap), and generates three alternative positioning variants — narrow-and-sharp, category-led, and outcome-quantified — each with H1, subhead, three reinforcing capability-led features, and a 7-axis tradeoff matrix. Outputs a structured markdown report with a recommended variant, message house, and surface adaptations (deck, LinkedIn, cold email, Product Hunt, sales one-liner). Stage-aware scoring thresholds adjust for seed / Series A / Series B+ context.
